document.title: Gemini Enterprise Pilot Statement of Work
document.subtitle: Customer Service Voice Agent Pilot

customer.profile: Lakeside Utilities Inc. is a regional water and power utility serving approximately 400,000 households. Its customer service organisation handles billing, outage reporting and service transfers through a 60-seat contact centre, and is evaluating conversational AI to absorb routine contact volume without proportional headcount growth.

background.objective: The objective of this pilot is to prove the value of Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience against a Lakeside-prioritised workflow. Premier Cloud and Lakeside will design and build a billing-enquiry voice agent, exercised against representative scenarios and measured on call containment, intent-resolution accuracy, average handle time against the current baseline, and tool-call accuracy.
business_challenges: Billing enquiries are high-volume, repeatable and script-driven, and account for roughly half of inbound contacts.
Seasonal outage events produce contact spikes the current staffing model cannot absorb without long queue times.

scope.statement: Lakeside's billing enquiry workflow is high-volume and script-driven, making it a strong candidate for an AI-augmented voice agent.
out_of_scope_extra: Outage reporting and service transfer workflows. Raised in discovery and deferred to a later phase.
Integration with the field dispatch system. Not required for the billing use case.
Replacement of the existing contact centre platform.

use_cases.name: Billing Enquiry
use_cases.summary: handles balance enquiries, payment arrangements and bill explanation, with verified caller identity and a warm transfer to an agent for anything outside the agreed scenarios.
use_cases.current_solution: The current billing enquiry workflow proceeds as follows:
current_solution_steps: **Initial Contact:** Calls arrive at the IVR, which performs basic menu triage.
**Routing:** The call is routed to an available customer service representative.
**Identity Verification:** The representative verifies the caller against account number and address.
**Resolution:** The representative looks up the balance, explains charges, and where requested sets up a payment arrangement.
**Escalation:** Disputed charges are escalated to the billing specialist queue.
use_cases.proposed_solution: Premier Cloud will design, build and demonstrate a billing enquiry voice agent on Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, in a controlled pilot environment within Lakeside's Google Cloud project. The agent verifies the caller, retrieves account balance and recent charges through an OpenAPI connector to a representative configuration of the billing system, explains the bill using approved language, and where in scope records a payment arrangement. Anything outside the agreed scenarios warm-transfers to a representative with the caller already verified and context attached.
use_cases.trigger: Inbound call via the Google Telephony Platform voice channel
success_metrics: Average handle time versus the 6m40s baseline
figures: The voice agent at a glance: caller, agent, and connected services
The billing enquiry target call flow

timeline.note: The pilot will run for eight (8) weeks, beginning March 16, 2026.

deliverables.detail: Project kickoff and governance setup, including discovery findings document
Solution Design Document covering agent architecture and integration design
OpenAPI connector configuration with smoke-test results and baseline measurement
Working demonstration of the billing enquiry voice agent with a UAT measurement summary
Training materials package and agent dashboard handover
Final pilot report and follow-up roadmap reviewed at pilot closure

risks.mitigation: Phase 1 prerequisite confirmation with a named technical contact and an escalation path via the PM.

risks.risk: Billing system API access or schema is not confirmed
risks.mitigation: Phase 1 prerequisite for documented endpoints; sample-data fallback where needed; written change request if integration complexity exceeds estimates.

success_criteria: The agent demonstrates end-to-end handling across the pilot scenarios agreed in Phase 1, including caller verification and warm transfer.
Measurements against the agreed success metrics are captured and shared with Lakeside stakeholders.
Lakeside's automation team is trained on agent operation, monitoring and tuning, with documented materials delivered.
A final pilot report and follow-up roadmap are delivered and reviewed at pilot close.
